questions.answer: कोंढाण्याचे सिंहगड हे नाव तानाजींच्या वीरतेच्या कारणे सार्थ झाले. सिंहगड म्हणजे सिंहाचा किल्ला, ज्याचा अर्थ वीर किल्ला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची कारणे तीन-चार वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: तानाजी सिंहासारखा लढत होता हे का?
questions.answer: तानाजी खूप वीर व शूर होता. त्याने सिंहासारखा शौर्य दर्शवला, त्यामुळे त्याला सिंहासारखा लढत होता सांगता येईल. त्याचा लढाई पद्धत सिंहासारखा होता. त्यामुळे त्याला सिंहासारखा लढत होता असे सांगता येईल.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची कारणे तीन-चार वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: जिजामाता शिवरायांना कोंढाणा घ्यायचे म्हणाल्या का?
questions.answer: जिजामाता ज्ञात होती की कोंढाणा एक बळकट किल्ला आहे. त्यामुळे त्याला मुघलांच्या हातात ठेवणे खतरनाक असते. ती शिवरायांना सावध राहायचे सल्ला देऊ इच्छली. त्यामुळे ती म्हणाल्या की कोंढाणा घ्यावे.

questions.text: गड चढताच तानाजी आणि त्याचे मावळे कल्याण दरवाजा उघडतो का?
questions.answer: गड चढताच तानाजी आणि त्याचे मावळे कल्याण दरवाजा उघडतो, ज्यामुळे त्यांची टोली किल्ल्यात पोहोच शकते. दरवाजा उघडण्यामुळे त्यांचे प्रवेश सोपे होतो. त्यामुळे लढाई सुरू झाली. त्यामुळे ते केली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तर सात-दहा ओटी लिहा.
questions.text: कोंढाण्याचा किल्ला कोणाच्या ताब्यात होता? तानाजीने त्याला घ्यायची कामगिरी कशी केली?
questions.answer: कोंढाण्याचा किल्ला मुगळांचा ताब्यात होता. तानाजी शिवरायांचा साथीदार होते, त्यामुळे शिवरायांनी त्याला किल्ला घ्यायची आज्ञा दिली. तानाजी आपल्या मावळ्यांशी किल्ल्याच्या डोंगर्यावर चढला. त्यांनी उदेभानाच्या टेकडीवर झोप घेतली व दोघांची झुंज गडाभोवती टेहळणी केली. त्याच्यावर धार झाली, पण ते हटले नाही. तानाजीने कल्याण दरवाजा उघडला व त्याच्यावर लढाई सुरू झाली. त्यामुळे किल्ल्यावर शिवरायांचा वर्चस्व स्थापित झाला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तर सात-दहा ओटी लिहा.
questions.text: तानाजींचा बलिदान कोंढाण्याच्या लढाईत कसे महत्त्वाचे होता?
questions.answer: तानाजींचा बलिदान कोंढाण्याच्या लढाईत खूप महत्त्वाचा होता. त्याने आपला प्राण गमावूनही किल्ल्यावर चढून कल्याण दरवाजा उघडला. त्यामुळे त्यांची टोली किल्ल्यात पोहोचली व लढाई सुरू झाली. तानाजींचा वीरता दिसून त्यांचे मावळे देखील लढत राहिले. त्यामुळे किल्ल्यावर शिवरायांचा वर्चस्व झाला. तानाजींचा बलिसाद सिंहगड हे नाव सार्थ झाले. त्यामुळे त्याचा बलिसाद स्मरण राहतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचे परिभाषा एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: वीर
questions.answer: वीर म्हणजे जो खूप शूर, साहसी व पराक्रमी असतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचे परिभाषा एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: बलिदान
questions.answer: बलिदान म्हणजे आपला प्राण किंवा काही महत्वाची गोष्ट त्यागून इतरांचे हित करणे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची स्पष्टीकरण चार-पाच वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: कोंढाण्याचा किल्ला कोणाच्या ताब्यात होता? त्यामुळे शिवरायांना काय समस्या होती?
questions.answer: कोंढाण्याचा किल्ला मुगळांचा ताब्यात होता. त्यामुळे शिवरायांना त्याला घ्यायचा खूप कठीण होता, कारण मुगळांची सेना शक्तिशाली होती. शिवरायांना डर होता की त्यात लढाल्यावर त्यांना पराभव येऊ शके. त्यामुळे त्याला सावधपणे यojana बनवायची हवी.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची स्पष्टीकरण चार-पाच वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: तानाजी सिंहासारखा लढत होता हे का सांगता येईल?
questions.answer: तानाजी खूप वीर व शूर होता. त्याने लढाईत सिंहासारखा शौर्य दर्शवला, ज्यामुळे त्याला सिंहासारखा लढत होता सांगता येईल. त्याने हाताला धार घेतली, पण हटला नाही. त्याचा साहस त्यांचे मावळ्यांना देखील प्रेरणा दिला. त्यामुळे त्याला सिंहासारखा लढत होता असे सांगता येईल.

questions.answer: रायगड

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेक करून घेण्याचे का ठरवले?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेक करून घेण्याचे ठरवले की स्वराज्याची सर्वत्र मान्यता होईल.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राजधानीसाठी रायगडाची निवड का केली?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी रायगडachi निवड केली क्यांकी तो मजबूत किल्ला होता व समुद्राने घिरला होता.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या दिवसाला कोणता नाव दिला गेला?
questions.answer: राज्याभिषेकाच्या दिवसाला महामंगल दिवस असा नाव दिला गेला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची दोन-तीन वाक्यांत उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेक केल्याने स्वराज्याची काय उपलब्धी केली?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेक केल्याने स्वराज्याची सर्वत्र मान्यता मिळवली. सर्व राजेरजवाड्यांनी त्याची स्वीकृती दिली. हा सोहळा स्वराज्याची वैधता स्थापित केला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची दोन-तीन वाक्यांत उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या सोहळ्यात गागाभट्टांचे काय योगदान होते?
questions.answer: गागाभट्टांनी राज्याभिषेकाचे पौरोहित्य केले. त्यांनी शिवरायांवर जलाभिषेक केला. त्यांचे मंत्रोच्चार सोहळ्याची पवित्रता वाढवित.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची दोन-तीन वाक्यांत उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या दिवस महाराष्ट्रातील लोकांना काय अनुभव झाला?
questions.answer: लोकांना खूप आनंद व गौरवाचा अनुभव झाला. डोळ्यांतून आनंदाश्रू बाहू पडले. सर्वत्र जयजयकार केला गेला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची दोन-तीन वाक्यांत उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेक केल्याने शककर्ते शक कसे सुरू केला?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेकacha दिवस १६७४ चे जेष्ठ शुक्ल त्रयोदशी हा शककर्ते शकाचा प्रथम दिवस माना केला. त्यापासून शककर्ते शकाची गणना सुरू केली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या सोहळ्यात कोणती सात नद्यांचे पाणी सोन्याच्या घागरीत भरले?
questions.answer: गंगा, सिंधू, यमुना, गोदावरी, कृष्णा, नर्मदा, कावेरी या सात नद्यांचे पाणी भरले गेले. हा प्रतीक स्वरूप स्वराज्याची अखंड व सर्वसमावेशी एकता दर्शवितो. नद्या जीवनदायिनी असल्यामुळे त्यांचे पाणी भरलेला घागर समृद्धी व शुद्धीचा प्रतीक बनला. हा सोहळा प्रकृती व मानवacha संतुलन देखील दर्शवितो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या राज्याभिषेक सोहळ्याचे वर्णन करा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या राज्याभिषेक सोहळा सन १६७४ मध्ये रायगडावर धूमधामाने साजरा केला गेला. हा दिवस महामंगल दिवस असे सांगितले जाते. सोहळ्यात सर्व महाराष्ट्रातील प्रजाजन, बिदूवान, सेनापती व धार्मिक नेते जमले. गागाभट्टांनी पौरोहित्य केले व शिवरायांवर सोन्याची घागर धरली, ज्यात सात नद्यांचे पाणी भरले होते. शिवरायांच्या डोळ्यांतून आनंदाश्रू बाहू पडले व सर्वांनी जयजयकार केला. हा सोहळा स्वराज्याची वैधता स्थापित केला व शककर्ते शकाचा सुरू केला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या सोहळ्यातील प्रतीकात्मक घटकांचे महत्त्व सांगा.
questions.answer: राज्याभिषेकाच्या सोहळ्यात अनेक प्रतीकात्मक घटक होते जे गहिरा अर्थ दर्शविते. सोन्याची घागर समृद्धी व शुद्धीचा प्रतीक होती. त्यात सात नद्यांचे पाणी भरले होते जे अखंडता व सर्वसमावेशीचा संदेश देऊनchte. छत्र व चामरे शौर्य व नेतृत्वाचा प्रतीक होते. जलाभिषेक पवित्रता व देवाच्या आशीर्वादाचा प्रतीक होता. जयजयकार व आनंदाश्रू लोकांच्या स्वीकृती व खुशीचा प्रतीक होते. हा सोहळा फक्त राजकीय नव्हे वरू सांस्कृतिक, आध्यात्मिक व सामाजिक एकत्वाचा देखील उत्सव होता.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: राज्याभिषेक
questions.answer: राज्याभिषेक म्हणजे राजा व coronationचा राजकीय व धार्मिक संस्कार ज्यात राजा formalmente शासक म्हणून मान्यता मिळतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शककर्ते
questions.answer: शककर्ते म्हणजे शक शकेचा आरांभ करणारा व त्याची गणना सुरू करणारा व्यक्ती, ज्यामध्ये शिवरायांनी राज्याभिषेकachen शककर्ते म्हणून मानले जाते.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: राज्याभिषेकाच्या सोहळ्यात जलाभिषेकाचे महत्त्व काय होते?
questions.answer: जलाभिषेक म्हणवाच पवित्र जलाने राजा व coronationचा अभिषेक करणे. हा संस्कार राजा ला पवित्रता व देवाच्या आशीर्वादाचा प्रतीक देतो. जल जीवनदायिनी असल्यामुळे ते समृद्धी, शुद्धी व नूतनीचीचा प्रतीक मानला जातो. राज्याभिषेकात जलाभिषेक करण्यामुळे शिवरायांचा शासन न्याय व कल्याणकारी असेल अशी कामना केली जाते. हा संस्कार भारतीय परंपราชा भाग आहे व राजा ला दैविक मान्यता देते.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे _______ ठखले.
questions.answer: संकल्प

questions.answer: स्वीकृत

questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तर एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले, याचा कारण काय होता?
questions.answer: दक्षिणेतील जहागीर सांभाळणे व मुगळ प्रतिकार करणे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले, याचे दोन कारण सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले, ज्यामुळे दक्षिणेतील जहागीर सांभाळली जाऊ शकती व मुगळ साम्राज्याचा प्रतिकार करणे शक्य होईल.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना समजुतीची पत्रे काय लिहिली व त्याचा प्रभाव काय होता?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना पत्रात लिहिले की परक्‍्या शत्रूंचा भरवसा धरू नये, हिंदवी स्वराज्य निर्माण केले, अखिल पुरुषार्थ गाजवावा. यामुळे व्यंकोजीराजांची मनःस्थिति सुदृढ झाली व त्यांचे सहयोग मिळाला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या दक्षिणेतील मोहिमेचे तीन परिणाम सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या दक्षिणेतील मोहिमेचे परिणाम: कर्नाटकातील विजय मिळवली, जिंजी किल्ला जिंकला, व्यंकोजीराजांची भेट झाली, व दक्षिणेत मजबूत ठाणे स्थापित झाले.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: कुतुबशाहाची राजधानी कोणती होती व त्याचा महत्त्व काय होता?
questions.answer: कुतुबशाहाची राजधानी गोवळकोंडा होती. त्याचा महत्त्व होता की ती दक्षिण दिग्बिजयासाठी ठिकाण होते व शिवरायांच्या भेटीचे ठिकाण होते.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले. का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले, कारण दक्षिणेतील जहागीर सांभाळणे आवश्यक होते. तसेच मुगळ साम्राज्याचा विस्तार रोकण्यासाठी दक्षिणेत मजबूत ठाणे हवी होती. यामुळे स्वराज्याची सुरक्षा व विस्तार शक्य होईल.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना वेलूरच्या किल्ल्याला गळ घातले. का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना वेलूरच्या किल्ल्याला गळ घातले, कारण त्यांच्याकडे विश्वासाची कमी झाली होती. व्यंकोजीराजे स्वत:च्या हितांसाठी काम करत होते, ज्यामुथे शिवरायांचे दक्षिणेतील उद्दिष्ट अडथळे पडत होते. यामुथे शिवरायांनी त्यांची शक्ति घातली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना पत्रात लिहिले, 'परक्‍्या शत्रूंचा भरवसा धरू नये.' का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना पत्रात लिहिले की परक्‍्या शत्रूंचा भरवसा धरू नये, कारण ते व्यंकोजीराजांचे मनःस्थिती समजून घेतले होते. ते जानते होते की व्यंकोजीराजे भरवसावाले असतील, त्यामुळे त्यांना सावध राहण्याची सल्ला देऊन त्यांचे विश्वास मिळवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या दक्षिणेतील मोहिमेचे विस्तृत वर्णन करा. त्यामुळे स्वराज्याला काय लाभ झाले?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या दक्षिणेतील मोहिमेचा उद्देश दक्षिणेतील जहागीर सांभाळणे व मुगळ प्रतिकार करणे होता. त्यामुथे शिवरायांनी कर्नाटकातील विजय मिळवली, जिंजी किल्ला जिंकला, व्यंकोजीराजांची भेट झाली. यामुळे दक्षिणेत मजबूत ठाणे स्थापित झाले, ज्यामुथे स्वराज्याची सुरक्षा व विस्तार शक्य होईल. यामुळे शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्याचा आधार मजबूत झाला व हिंदवी स्वराज्याचा निर्माण झाला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवराय व व्यंकोजीराजे यांच्या संबंधांचे वर्णन करा. त्यांचे सहयोग व मतभेद काय होते?
questions.answer: शिवराय व व्यंकोजीराजे सावत्र भाऊ होते. त्यांचे संबंध प्रारंभात सnehपूर्ण होते, परंतु नंतर त्यांच्यामध्ये विश्वासाची कमी झाली. शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना दक्षिणेतील ठिकाणी ठेवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला, परंतु व्यंकोजीराजे स्वत:च्या हितांसाठी काम करत होते. यामुथे शिवरायांनी त्यांचे वेलूरच्या किल्ल्याला गळ घातले. त्यानंतरही शिवरायांनी त्यांना प्रदेश दिला व त्यांचे कल्याण करण्याचा प्रयत्न केला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: स्वराज्य
questions.answer: स्वराज्याचा अर्थ स्वयंचालित राज्य आहे, ज्यामध्ये लोक स्वतःचे नियम तयार करतात व स्वतःचे कार्य करतात.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: जहागीर
questions.answer: जहागीराचा अर्थ एका विशेष क्षेत्राचा नियंत्रण आहे, ज्यामध्ये कर वसूली व प्रशासनाचा अधिकार असतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले. त्याचा अर्थ स्पष्ट करा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी दक्षिण आपल्या ताब्यात घेण्याचे ठखले, याचा अर्थ आहे की ते दक्षिणेतील क्षेत्रात आस्थायित्व ठेवण्याचा निर्णय घेतले होते. ते फक्त अस्थायी राहणे नाही, तर स्थायी ठिकाणी राहून जहागीर सांभाळणे, सेना तयार करणे व मुगळ प्रतिकार करणे यासाठी ठेवले होते. यामुळे स्वराज्याचा आधार मजबूत झाला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना पत्रात लिहिले, 'परक्‍्या शत्रूंचा भरवसा धरू नये.' याचा स्पष्टीकरण द्या.
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी व्यंकोजीराजांना पत्रात लिहिले की परक्‍्या शत्रूंचा भरवसा धरू नये, याचा अर्थ आहे की ते व्यंकोजीराजांना सल्ला देत होते की त्यांना परकीय शत्रूंचा भरवसा करणे हवं नाही. त्यामुळे ते स्वत:च्या शक्तीवर भरवसा राखून, हिंदवी स्वराज्याचा निर्माण करणे हवं. यामुळे व्यंकोजीराजांचे मनःस्थिती सुदृढ झाले व त्यांचे सहयोग मिळाला.

questions.text: खालील बाजूचे पदे जोडा.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणती एका शब्दाची वर्ग भidin?
questions.answer: नदी - हे जलस्रोत आहे, शेष किल्ले/दुर्गचे पर्यायवाची आहेत.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: खालीलपैकी कोणती एका वस्तू किल्ल्यावर वापरली जाऊ शकत नाही?
questions.answer: जुना कपडा - हे किल्ल्यांच्या संरक्षण व व्यवस्थापनात वापरले जाते, शेष सैनिक सामग्री आहेत.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचे एका शब्दाने नाव काय आहे?
questions.answer: कौशल्य

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: जलदुर्गांचे एका पर्यायवाची नाव काय आहे?
questions.answer: जंजिरा

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत वापरलेली जहाजाची एका प्रकार काय आहे?
questions.answer: गुराब

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी करण्यासाठी किल्ल्यांची प्रतिकृती तयार करणे काय सांगते?
questions.answer: आकर्षण

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापनात किल्लेदाराची एका मुख्य काम काय आहे?
questions.answer: संरक्षण

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी किल्ल्यावर कोणती दोन मूलभूत सुविधा उपलब्ध केली?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी किल्ल्यावर पाण्याची व घरांची व्यवस्था केली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी कधी केली जाते?
questions.answer: गडकोटांची उभारणी दिवाळीच्या सुट्टीत केली जाते.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत कोणती जहाजे वापरली जात होती?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत गुराब, गलबत, पाल, मचवा, नाव, होडी जहाजे वापरली जात होती.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: जलदुर्गांचे एका उदाहरण काय आहे?
questions.answer: सिंधुदुर्ग जलदुर्गाचा एका उदाहरण आहे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचा एका लक्षण काय आहे?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचे लक्षण निश्‍चित ध्येय साधणे आहे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचे दोन महत्त्व सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्याने स्वराज्याची स्थापना केली आणि किल्ल्यांचे संरक्षण करण्यासाठी तयार केले. यामुळे राज्याची सुरक्षा व व्यवस्था राहिली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी करण्यासाठी विद्यार्थी काय करू शकतो?
questions.answer: विद्यार्थी किल्ल्यांची प्रतिकृती तयार करू शकतो, त्यात किल्ल्यांचे विविध भागे जाणून घेऊ शकतो, आणि किल्ल्यांचे महत्त्व समजून घेऊ शकतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत वापरलेली शिशाच्या गोळ्यांचे वापर काय होता?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत शिशाच्या गोळ्यांचा वापर तोफांचे शत्रूवर मार करण्यासाठी केला जात होता. ते लोखंडी, दगडी ब कुलपी होती.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: किल्लेदाराची दोन कामे सांगा.
questions.answer: किल्लेदाराची कामे किल्ल्याचे संरक्षण व कारभार करणे आणि गडावर राहणाऱ्या लोकांना धान्य व वस्तूचा वितरण करणे आहेत.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी किल्ल्यावर पाण्याची व्यवस्था केली का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी किल्ल्यावर पाण्याची व्यवस्था केली ज्यामुळे किल्ल्यामध्ये राहणाऱ्या सैनिकांसाठी पाणी उपलब्ध राहिल. यामुळे लांब कालखंडापर्यंत किल्ले टिकवता येईल. पाण्याची कमी न झाल्यामुळे सैनिकांची क्षमता वाढली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी दिवाळीच्या सुट्टीत केली जाते का?
questions.answer: गडकोटांची उभारणी दिवाळीच्या सुट्टीत केली जाते कारण तेथे शाळा बंद असते आणि मित्रे एकत्र होतात. यामुळे त्यांच्याकडे वेळ व सहयोग मिळतो. सुट्टीत केल्यामुळे शाळेतील पाठ्यक्रमावर असरही होत नाही.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत जहाजे वापरली जात होती का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या आरमारीत जहाजे वापरली जात होती त्यामुळे समुद्रातील शत्रूंचा सामना केला जाऊ शकेल. जहाजे मदतीन्याने समुद्रकिनारा सुरक्षित केला गेला. यामुळे स्वराज्याची रक्षा झाली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचे महत्त्व सांगा व त्यांचे तुमच्या दैनंदिन जीवनात उपयुक्त उपाय सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्याने स्वराज्याची स्थापना केली, किल्ल्यांचे संरक्षण केला, पाण्याची व घरांची व्यवस्था केली, आणि आरमाराची तयारी केली. यामुळे राज्य सुरक्षित राहिला. तुमच्या दैनंदिन जीवनात हे कौशल्य वापरता येईल: शाळेतील कामे नियोजितपणे करणे, सामग्रींचे हिशोब ठेवणे, मित्रांसह सहकार्य करणे, व स्वच्छता व व्यवस्था ठेवणे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी करण्याची पद्धत सांगा व त्यातील शैक्षिक मूल्य सांगा.
questions.answer: गडकोटांची उभारणी दिवाळीच्या सुट्टीत मित्रांच्या मदतीने केली जाते. विद्यार्थी किल्ल्यांची प्रतिकृती तयार करतात, त्यात किल्ल्यांचे नाव, भागे, महत्त्व जाणून घेतात. यामुळे त्यांच्याकडे ऐतिहासिक जाणिव, रचनात्मकता, टीम वर्क, व भौगोलिक जाणिव वाढते. यामुळे त्यांच्याकडे किल्ल्यांचे संरक्षण व आदर वाढतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: गडकोटांचे अर्थ सांगा.
questions.answer: गडकोटांचा अर्थ किल्ले किंवा दुर्ग आहे.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची एका वाक्यात उत्तरे लिहा.
questions.text: व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचा अर्थ सांगा.
questions.answer: व्यवस्थापन कौशल्य म्हणजे निश्‍चित ध्येय साधण्यासाठी हाती घेतलेले कार्य.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्यांचे स्वराज्याची स्थापनातील भूमिका सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या व्यवस्थापन कौशल्याने स्वराज्याची स्थापना केली. त्यांनी किल्ल्यांची उभारणी केली, पाण्याची व घरांची व्यवस्था केली, आरमाराची तयारी केली, आणि सामग्रींचा हिशोब ठेवला. यामुळे राज्याची सुरक्षा, स्वावलंबन, व सैनिक शक्ती वाढली. यामुळे स्वराज्याची स्थापना संभव झाली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: गडकोटांची उभारणी करण्याचे विद्यार्थ्यांवर होणारा प्रभाव सांगा.
questions.answer: गडकोटांची उभारणी करण्यामुळे विद्यार्थ्यांमध्ये ऐतिहासिक जाणिव वाढते, त्यांना किल्ल्यांचे महत्त्व समजते. यामुळे त्यांच्याकडे रचनात्मकता, टीम वर्क, व समस्या समाधानाची क्षमता वाढते. यामुळे त्यांच्याकडे किल्ल्यांचे संरक्षण व आदर वाढतो, आणि त्यांच्याकडे राष्ट्रप्रेम वाढतो.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राज्यकारभाराची आठ खात्यांत विभागणी केली, त्यामुळे प्रत्येक खात्याचा प्रमुख _______ असेल.
questions.answer: अष्टप्रधान

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी शिवरायांनी सागवानांचे पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या _______ करणे प्रतिबंधित केले.
questions.answer: हात

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी गडांवरील _______ बांधून पाणी साठवले.
questions.answer: बंधारे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या काळात स्त्रियांचा सन्मान _______ केला जातो.
questions.answer: वाढवला

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दुष्काळग्रस्त क्षेत्रातील शेतकऱ्यांना _______ देत होते.
questions.answer: काम

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील कथनांची सत्यता तपासा व बरोबर/चूक लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी नवीन पेडे लावणे परवानगी दिली होती.
questions.answer: चूक

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील कथनांची सत्यता तपासा व बरोबर/चूक लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील दुष्काळाची कधीही तीव्रता जाणवली नाही.
questions.answer: बरोबर

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील कथनांची सत्यता तपासा व बरोबर/चूक लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी स्त्रियांचा सन्मान कमी केला.
questions.answer: चूक

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील कथनांची सत्यता तपासा व बरोबर/चूक लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी तळे व टाक्ये बांधून पाणी साठवले.
questions.answer: बरोबर

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: खालील अष्टप्रधानांचे नाव व त्यांचे काम जोडा.
questions.answer: मोरो त्रिंबक पिंगळे – राज्यकारभार चालवणे, रामचंद्र नीळकंठ मुजुमदार – राज्याचा जमाखर्च पाहणे, हंबीरराव मोहिते – सैन्याचे नेतृत्व करणे, मोरेश्वर पंडितराव – धर्माची कामे पाहणे, निराजी रावजी – न्यायदान करणे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी स्वराज्यत जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी कोणती योजना सुरू केली?
questions.answer: गडांवरील बंधारे बांधून पाणी साठवणे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी शिवरायांनी कोणती पद्धत अपनवली?
questions.answer: सागवाना पेडे तोडणे प्रतिबंधित करणे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यात स्त्रियांचा सन्मान कसे वाढवला?
questions.answer: स्त्रियांना अतिशय मानाने वागणूक देणे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी दुष्काळ निवारणासाठी कोणती व्यवस्था केली?
questions.answer: जलयुक्त Brae योजना सुरू करणे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी राज्यकारभाराची विभागणी कोठे केली?
questions.answer: अष्टप्रधान मंडळ

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी शिवरायांनी कोणते पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले?
questions.answer: सागवाना

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी कोणती संरचना बांधली?
questions.answer: बंधारे

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या काळात स्त्रियांचा सन्मान कसे केला?
questions.answer: वाढवला

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: दुष्काळात शिवरायांनी शेतकऱ्यांना कोणती सुविधा दिली?
questions.answer: काम

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी कोणती पद्धत अपनवली?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले व नवीन पेडे लावण्याची परवानगी दिली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे एका वाक्यात लिहा.

questions.answer: शिवरायांनी गडांवरील बंधारे बांधून पाणी साठवण्याची योजना सुरू केली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: दुष्काळात शिवरायांनी शेतकऱ्यांना कोणती मदत केली?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी दुष्काळात शेतकऱ्यांना काम दिले व अनाज मोफत वाटून दिले.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील अष्टप्रधान मंडळाचा मुख्य उद्देश्य काय होता?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील अष्टप्रधान मंडळाचा मुख्य उद्देश्य राज्यकारभार व्यवस्थित चालवणे होता.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी कोणती पद्धती अपनवली? तिचे फायदे सांगा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले व नवीन पेडे लावण्याची परवानगी दिली. त्यामुळे जंगले संरक्षित राहिल्यामुळे पाऊस यकीनवंत राहिल्यामुळे जलस्रोत संरक्षित राहिले.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी कोणती व्यवस्था केली? ते दुष्काळात कसे उपयुक्त होते?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी गडांवरील बंधारे बांधून पावसाचे पाणी साठवले. त्यामुळे दुष्काळातही पाणी उपलब्ध राहिल्यामुळे शेती व पिण्याची समस्या टाळली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी स्त्रियांचा सन्मान कसे वाढवला? त्यामुळे समाजावर कोणता प्रभाव पडला?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी स्त्रियांना अतिशय मानाने वागणूक देणे व त्यांचे धार्मिक हक्क राखणे. त्यामुळे स्त्रियांचे सामाजिक मान वाढला व त्यांनी स्वराज्य विकासात सहभागी झाले.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: दुष्काळात शिवरायांनी शेतकऱ्यांना कोणती मदत केली? ते कसे लोककल्याणकारी होते?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी दुष्काळात शेतकऱ्यांना काम दिले, अनाज मोफत वाटून दिले व वस्त्र देऊन. त्यामुळे शेतकऱ्यांचे जीवन निर्वाह शक्य झाला व त्यांच्या आर्थिक स्थिती सुधारली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले का?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले कारण त्यांचे मानना होता की पेडे पर्यावरण संतुलन ठेवतात. पेडे तोडण्याने पाऊस कमी होतो, जामिन эрозиन वाढतो व जंतूांचे वासस्थळ नष्ट होतो. त्यामुळे त्यांनी पेडे संरक्षित राखण्याचा नियम बनवला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील दुष्काळाची कधीही तीव्रता जाणवली नाही असे का सांगता येते?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी गडांवरील बंधारे बांधून पावसाचे पाणी साठवले. त्यामुळे दुष्काळातही पाणी उपलब्ध राहिला. पाण्याची उपलब्धता शेती व पिण्यासाठी असल्यामुळे अन्नसंपन्नता बनी राहिली. त्यामुळे दुष्काळाची तीव्रता जाणवली नाही.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी स्त्रियांचा सन्मान वाढवण्यासाठी अतिशय मानाने वागणूक देणे का केला?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी स्त्रियांचा सन्मान वाढवण्यासाठी अतिशय मानाने वागणूक देणे केला कारण त्यांचे मानना होता की स्त्रiye समाजACHE आधार स्तंभ आहेत. त्यांचे मान वाढवण्याने त्यांचे सहभागी वाढवले व त्यांनी स्वराज्य विकासात योगदान दिले. त्यामुळे सामाजिक एकता व समृद्धी वाढली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे ६-१० रिकाम्या ओटीं लिहा.
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील लोककल्याणकारी व्यवस्थांचे वर्णन करा. पर्यावरण रक्षण, जल व्यवस्थापन, स्त्रियांचा सन्मान व दुष्काळ निवारण यांचा समावेश करा.
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील लोककल्याणकारी व्यवस्थांचा मुख्य उद्देश्य प्रजेचा सुख व समृद्धी होते. त्यांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले व नवीन पेडे लावण्याची परवानगी दिली. जल व्यवस्थापनासाठी गडांवरील बंधारे बांधून पावसाचे पाणी साठवले, ज्यामुळे दुष्काळातही पाणी उपलब्ध राहिला. स्त्रियांचा सन्मान वाढवण्यासाठी त्यांना अतिशय मानाने वागणूक दिले व त्यांचे धार्मिक हक्क राखले. दुष्काळात शेतकऱ्यांना काम दिले, अनाज मोफत वाटून दिले व वस्त्र देऊन. त्यामुळे स्वराज्यात प्रजा सुखी, समृद्ध व शांतिपूर्ण राहिली.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील प्रश्नांची उत्तरे ६-१० रिकाम्या ओटीं लिहा.
questions.text: अष्टप्रधान मंडळाची संरचना व त्यांचे कामे सांगा. प्रत्येक अष्टप्रधानाचे नाव व त्यांचे प्रमुख काम लिहा.
questions.answer: अष्टप्रधान मंडळ शिवरायांनी राज्यकारभार व्यवस्थित चालवण्यासाठी आठ खात्यांत विभागित केला होता. त्यातील अष्टप्रधान व त्यांचे काम: १. मोरो त्रिंबक पिंगळे - प्रधान, राज्यकारभार चालवणे. २. रामचंद्र नीळकंठ मुजुमदार - अमात्य, राज्याचा जमाखर्च पाहणे. ३. हंबीरराव मोहिते - सेनापती, सैन्याचे नेतृत्व करणे. ४. मोरेश्वर पंडितराव - पंडितराव, धर्माची कामे पाहणे. ५. निराजी रावजी - न्यायाधीश, न्यायदान करणे. ६. अण्णाजी दत्तो - सचिव, सरकारी आज्ञापत्रे पाठवणे. ७. दत्ताजी त्रिंबक वाकनीस - मंत्री, पत्रव्यवहार सांभाळणे. ८. रामचंद्र त्रिबक डबीर - सुमंत, परराज्यांशी संबंध ठेवणे. त्यामुळे प्रत्येक खात्याचा काम स्पष्ट झाला व राज्यकारभार व्यवस्थित चालवला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचे परिभाषा एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: लोककल्याणकारी स्वराज्य
questions.answer: लोककल्याणकारी स्वराज्य म्हणून प्रजेचा सुख, समृद्धी व हक्कांचे संरक्षण करणारा राज्य.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.instruction: खालील शब्दांचे परिभाषा एका वाक्यात लिहा.
questions.text: जल व्यवस्थापन
questions.answer: जल व्यवस्थापन म्हणून पाण्याचा संग्रह, संरक्षण व वापराची योजनेदारी प्रक्रिया.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी कोणती पद्धती अपनवली? ते कसे प्रभावी होते?
questions.answer: शिवरायांनी पर्यावरण रक्षणासाठी सागवाना पेडे तोडण्याऱ्या प्रतिबंधित केले व नवीन पेडे लावण्याची परवानगी दिली. त्यामुळे जंगले संरक्षित राहिल्यामुळे पाऊस यकीनवंत राहिल्यामुळे जलस्रोत संरक्षित राहिले. पेडे हवेतून कार्बन डायऑक्साइड सोकतात व ऑक्सीजन उत्पादन करतात, ज्यामुहू हवेची शुद्धता टिकवली. पेडे मातींचे अपरदन टाळतात, ज्यामुळे जामिन उर्वरा राहिली. त्यामुळे पर्यावरण संतुलन ठेवला व प्रजेचा आरोग्य व आजीविका संरक्षित राहिला.

questions.subject: EVS Part 2
questions.text: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील अष्टप्रधान मंडळाचा महत्त्व काय होता?
questions.answer: शिवरायांच्या स्वराज्यातील अष्टप्रधान मंडळाचा महत्त्व राज्यकारभार व्यवस्थित चालवण्यात होता. अष्टप्रधान मंडळामुळे प्रत्येक विभागाचा काम स्पष्ट झाला व जबाबदारी वाढली. त्यामुळे भ्रष्टाचार कमी होऊ शकल व निर्णय प्रक्रिया द्रुत झाली. अष्टप्रधान मंडळामुळे विशेषज्ञता व दक्षता आधारित व्यवस्थापन संभव झाला. त्यामुळे स्वराज्याची स्थिरता व विकास सुनिश्चित झाला.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why should we use transitional phrases like 'first', 'then', 'finally' while speaking?
questions.answer: We should use transitional phrases to make our speech clear and organized. They help the listener follow our ideas step by step. Without them, our talk may seem confusing or jumpy. Using such phrases makes our conversation sound natural and easy to understand.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is it good to talk about our likes and dislikes with friends?
questions.answer: Talking about likes and dislikes helps us know each other better and build stronger friendships. It helps us find common interests to play or work together. It also teaches us to respect differences in choices. This makes our conversations friendly and meaningful.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why should we celebrate national festivals together?
questions.answer: Celebrating national festivals together brings unity and pride in our country. It helps us learn about our culture, history, and values. Sharing joy with others spreads happiness and peace. Such celebrations remind us of our shared identity as Indians.

questions.answer: My favourite festival is Diwali, the festival of lights. I love it because we clean and decorate our house with lights and rangoli. questions.text: Explain how conversation starters help us talk with others.
questions.answer: Conversation starters are simple questions that help begin a talk. They make it easy to share our thoughts and feelings. By asking about likes, games, or festivals, we find common interests. This helps us feel comfortable and build friendship. Good starters lead to longer and more meaningful conversations.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why we should speak politely while talking to others.
questions.answer: Speaking politely shows respect and kindness toward others. It makes the listener feel valued and happy to talk. Polite words like 'please', 'thank you', and 'sorry' create a friendly atmosphere. It helps avoid misunderstandings and arguments. When we speak politely, others are more likely to listen and respond well.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Describe the clever way Birbal answered Akbar's question about the number of crows.
questions.answer: Birbal gave a specific number—fifty thousand three hundred and forty-nine—to show he had thought about it. When Akbar questioned what if more or fewer crows were found, Birbal gave logical, humorous replies: extra crows could be visitors from neighbouring kingdoms, and fewer could mean some had gone on vacation. This showed his quick wit and ability to turn a tricky question into a light-hearted moment.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do you think Akbar enjoyed Birbal's answers?
questions.answer: Akbar enjoyed Birbal's answers because they were wise, humorous, and showed deep thinking without being rude or defensive. Birbal never lost his calm and always had a smile-ready reply, which made the emperor laugh and appreciate his intelligence. Their interaction reflected a bond of trust and joy in the court.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: What does the story teach us about handling difficult questions?
questions.answer: The story teaches us that instead of getting nervous or giving a vague answer, we can use wisdom, humour, and logic to respond cleverly. Birbal showed that a calm mind can turn a tricky situation into a pleasant one. It encourages us to think before we speak and to answer with confidence and creativity.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: How did Birbal use imagination in his answers?
questions.answer: Birbal used imagination by suggesting that crows could travel like people—visiting relatives or going on vacation. He turned a simple counting question into a fun idea about crow behaviour. This creative thinking made his answers both logical and entertaining.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Birbal not give an exact count when Akbar first asked about the number of crows?
questions.answer: Birbal did not give an exact count at first because it is impossible to count all the crows in a kingdom accurately, as they keep flying in and out. He wanted to avoid giving a false promise. So, he used a smart and humorous way to answer without being misleading.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Akbar laugh at Birbal's replies?
questions.answer: Akbar laughed because Birbal's answers were not only clever but also full of humour and imagination. Instead of being serious or defensive, Birbal replied in a way that made the situation light and enjoyable. Akbar appreciated his minister's wit and presence of mind.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is Birbal considered wise in this story?
questions.answer: Birbal is considered wise because he answered a tricky question with calmness, logic, and humour. He did not panic or give a random guess but used reasoning to explain why the number could change. His answers showed deep thinking and emotional intelligence.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Imagine you are Birbal. Akbar asks you, 'How many stars are there in the sky?' Give a clever answer like Birbal would.
questions.answer: Your Majesty, there are as many stars in the sky as there are hopes in the hearts of your people. If we count more tonight, it is because some stars have come closer to listen to your greatness. If we count fewer, it is because they have gone to rest, just like your loyal subjects after a long day of service. The sky, like your kingdom, is full of wonder—never the same twice, yet always magnificent.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Write a short story about a clever answer given by a student to a teacher's tricky question.
questions.answer: One day, the teacher asked the class, 'If a frog jumps out of a well, how many jumps will it take?' Most students started calculating, but Raoh stood up and said, 'It depends on the frog’s mood, Teacher! If it’s happy, it might jump out in one big leap. If it’s tired, it may take many small jumps and rest on the way.' The teacher smiled and said, 'That’s a very clever answer—you didn’t just count jumps, you thought about the frog’s feelings too!' The class laughed, and Raoh felt proud for thinking differently.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why Birbal's answers were not just funny but also showed deep thinking.
questions.answer: Birbal's answers were funny because they used imaginative ideas like crows visiting relatives or going on vacation, which made Akbar laugh. But beneath the humour, there was deep thinking: he acknowledged that the number of crows is not fixed and can change due to natural movement. He avoided giving a false fixed number and instead showed understanding of nature and behaviour. His replies also protected the dignity of the court by keeping the mood light. Thus, his wit was a blend of wisdom, creativity, and emotional intelligence.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the story encourages students to think creatively.
questions.answer: The story encourages creative thinking by showing that not all questions have one fixed answer, and sometimes a clever reply is better than a literal one. Birbal did not just count crows—he thought about their behaviour, movement, and even emotions like visiting family or needing rest. This teaches students to look beyond the obvious and use imagination in their responses. It also builds confidence that it’s okay to think differently and express ideas with humour. Ultimately, the story promotes flexible thinking and joy in learning.

questions.text: Describe what happened when Pawan found the coin and showed it to his Aai.

questions.text: What did Aai do after learning that the coin did not belong to them?
questions.answer: Aai told Pawan that keeping the coin would be wrong. She took him outside and asked him to announce that a coin had been found. After some time, a poor man came and claimed it was his.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: How did Pawan feel at the end of the story and why?
questions.answer: Pawan felt proud and happy at the end. Although he did not get sweets, he felt good because he had been honest and done the right thing.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Aai insist on returning the coin instead of keeping it?
questions.answer: Aai insisted on returning the coin because it did not belong to them. She believed that keeping something that is not yours is wrong, even if it makes you happy for a moment.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Pawan feel proud after returning the coin?
questions.answer: Pawan felt proud because he chose honesty over personal gain. By returning the coin, he did the right thing, which gave him inner happiness and satisfaction. This act made him feel good about himself.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Aai speak lovingly but seriously to Pawan?
questions.answer: Aai spoke lovingly to show her care and affection for Pawan. She spoke seriously to teach him an important value — honesty. Her tone helped Pawan understand the lesson without feeling scared.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did the poor man have tears in his eyes when he got his coin back?
questions.answer: The poor man had tears in his eyes because the coin was his only possession. Losing it had made him helpless, and getting it back brought deep gratitude and relief. He was touched by Pawan and Aai’s honesty.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Describe the incident of the found coin and explain how honesty brought happiness to Pawan.
questions.answer: Pawan found a coin on the road and wanted to buy sweets. He showed it to his Aai, who asked if it was his. When he said he found it, she told him it belonged to someone else and must be returned. She made him announce the found coin. A poor man came and claimed it. Aai returned the coin to him. Pawan did not get sweets but felt proud and happy. He learned that truth and honesty bring real happiness, which is better than temporary joy.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Explain the role of Aai in teaching Pawan the value of honesty.
questions.answer: Aai played a key role in teaching Pawan honesty. When Pawan showed her the found coin, she did not praise him for finding it. Instead, she asked if it was his, guiding him to think. She explained that keeping it would be wrong. She then took action by making him announce the loss. Her calm, loving, yet firm approach helped Pawan understand the importance of doing the right thing. Through her words and actions, she taught him that honesty brings lasting happiness.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why Aai did not let Pawan keep the coin even though he was sad.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the poet say 'Let’s do it again, come on, my dear!'?

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why should you 'Stop and freeze, don’t even blink' in the poem?
questions.answer: Stopping and freezing helps to develop control over the body. Not blinking adds a fun challenge to stay still. It builds concentration and makes the game more engaging. This contrast with movement makes the action more enjoyable.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is it important to 'land with ease' after jumping up high?
questions.answer: Landing with ease prevents injury and promotes safe movement. It teaches balance and control after a jump. It makes the action smooth and graceful. This helps children learn to jump safely in play.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the poem include actions like 'wiggle fingers' and 'strike a pose'?
questions.answer: These actions encourage creativity and self-expression. Wiggling fingers develops fine motor skills. Striking a pose builds body awareness and confidence. Together, they make the activity fun and imaginative.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Describe your favorite action from the poem and why you like it. How would you teach it to a friend?
questions.answer: My favorite action from the poem is 'Jump up high, then land with ease' because it makes me feel strong and happy. I like the feeling of going up and coming down smoothly. To teach it to a friend, I would first show how to bend the knees before jumping. Then, I would jump and stretch my arms up. Finally, I would land softly on my toes with bent knees. I would ask my friend to try it slowly at first. We would practice together and count how many times we can do it. It would be fun to do it with music. I would cheer for my friend when they try. This way, we both learn and enjoy the action.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Imagine you are the teacher. How would you use the poem 'Fun With Actions' in your class to teach English and movement?
questions.answer: I would start by reading the poem aloud with actions so students can listen and follow. Then, I would teach new words like 'wave', 'shake', 'wiggle' and 'cheer' by doing the actions. Students would repeat the lines while performing the movements to remember the words. We would play a game where I say a line and they do the action. Later, they would work in pairs to give and follow action instructions. We would also find opposites like fast-slow, up-down, stop-go. Finally, students would draw their favorite action and write one sentence about it. This way, they learn English words, improve listening, and enjoy physical activity.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the poem 'Fun With Actions' helps in learning English action words.
questions.answer: The poem uses simple action words like wave, run, shake, touch, turn, and clap in a fun, rhythmic way. By doing the actions while saying the words, children connect the word with the movement, which helps them remember it better. The repetition of lines and actions strengthens memory and pronunciation. The joyful tone makes learning enjoyable, so children want to participate. This method builds vocabulary, listening skills, and confidence in using English words for actions.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why following instructions in the poem is important for young learners.
questions.answer: Following instructions in the poem helps children develop listening skills and the ability to understand and act on directions. It improves body coordination as they perform actions like jumping, shaking, and turning. It teaches them to wait for cues and act in sequence, which builds self-control. Doing actions together in a group promotes cooperation and social skills. This activity also lays the foundation for reading and following written instructions later in life.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did the teacher decide to have 'A Day without Rules'?
questions.answer: The teacher wanted the children to understand the importance of rules by experiencing what happens when there are none. She hoped they would realize that rules help keep the class peaceful and happy.

questions.subject: English

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did the headmaster smile when he saw the clean classroom?

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why should we use polite words like please and thank you in class?

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Describe how Grade Four became the neat and happiest class after the Day without Rules.

The teacher then reminded them of classroom etiquettes like listening, raising hands, keeping the class clean, and using polite words. Together, they cleaned the room and promised to follow the rules every day. From that day on, Grade Four became the neatest and happiest class in the school because everyone respected the rules and cared for each other.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why classroom rules are necessary for a good learning environment.
questions.answer: Classroom rules are necessary because they help maintain order and discipline, which allows every student to learn without distraction. Keeping the class clean and using polite words create a respectful and safe atmosphere. Without rules, the class becomes chaotic, as seen in the story, and students feel unhappy and unable to focus. Therefore, rules help build a positive environment where both teachers and students can work together happily.

questions.answer: The poet repeats the pattern to create a musical and predictable flow in the poem. This helps children anticipate what might happen next and enjoy the rhythm. It also emphasizes the continuous journey of imagination. The repetition makes the poem easy to remember and recite.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Imagine you caught a little rhyme. Describe what it would turn into and what you would do with it.
questions.answer: If I caught a little rhyme, I would take it home and keep it in my pocket. It might turn into a bright red balloon that floats above my head. Then I would let it go and watch it change into a butterfly with rainbow wings. The butterfly could fly to the garden and become a singing flower. I would follow it and hear it hum my favorite tune. Finally, it might turn into a chocolate bar that I could share with my friends. This shows how a small idea can bring big joy.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Write a summary of the poem 'Catch a Little Rhyme'.
questions.answer: The poem 'Catch a Little Rhyme' by Eve Merriam tells the story of a poet who catches a little rhyme. She tries to hold it, but it keeps changing into different things. First, it runs out the door, then melts into an icicle when chased on a bicycle. It becomes a cat in her hat, a whale when caught by the tail, and a goat in a boat. After being fed tin and paper, it turns into a skyscraper, then grows into a kite and flies out of sight. The poem shows how imagination can turn a simple idea into endless possibilities. It is fun, rhythmic, and encourages creativity in children.

questions.text: Explain the central idea of the poem 'Catch a Little Rhyme'.
questions.answer: The central idea of the poem is that imagination can transform simple things into wonderful adventures. The poet shows how a little rhyme, when chased or changed, turns into many surprising forms like an icicle, a cat, a whale, and finally a kite. Each change happens because of the poet’s actions and creative thinking. The poem encourages readers to use their imagination and see magic in everyday things. It teaches that ideas can grow and take us far if we believe in them.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the poem uses rhyme and rhythm to make it enjoyable.
questions.answer: The poem uses rhyme at the end of many lines, such as 'floor' and 'door', 'bicycle' and 'icicle', which creates a musical sound. The rhythm is steady and easy to follow, making it fun to read aloud or clap along. The repeated pattern of action and change gives it a predictable yet exciting flow. This helps children remember the poem and enjoy saying it again and again. The rhyme and rhythm together make the poem lively and engaging for young learners.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: How is Maharashtra day celebrated in schools?

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is 1st May celebrated as Labour Day in Maharashtra?
questions.answer: 1st May is celebrated as Labour Day in Maharashtra to honour the contributions of workers to society. It reminds people to respect all labourers, including factory workers, drivers, and cleaners. The day highlights the dignity of labour and the importance of workers' rights.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: What are the neighbouring states of Maharashtra?
questions.answer: The neighbouring states of Maharashtra are Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Goa. It also shares a border with the union territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu. To the west lies the Arabian Sea.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: What is the significance of unfurling the flag on Maharashtra day?
questions.answer: Unfurling the flag on Maharashtra day symbolizes state pride and unity. It is a mark of respect for the state's identity and sovereignty. The act is accompanied by singing the Rajyageet and remembering the state's formation in 1960.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is Maharashtra day celebrated on 1st May?
questions.answer: Maharashtra day is celebrated on 1st May because the state of Maharashtra was officially formed on this day in 1960. It marks the linguistic reorganisation of states based on the Marathi-speaking population. The day is observed to honour the state's cultural and historical identity.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do we respect workers on Kamgar Din?
questions.answer: We respect workers on Kamgar Din because they contribute significantly to the development of society and the economy. Their labour in factories, transport, sanitation, and other sectors keeps the state functioning. Recognizing their efforts promotes dignity and social justice.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is Mumbai called the Financial Capital of India?
questions.answer: Mumbai is called the Financial Capital of India because it hosts the Bombay Stock Exchange, Reserve Bank of India, and headquarters of many major banks and corporations. It is the centre of India's financial transactions, capital markets, and banking activities. The city's economic influence extends nationwide.

questions.text: Write a short paragraph on how Maharashtra day is celebrated in your school.
questions.answer: In our school, Maharashtra day is celebrated with great enthusiasm. The day begins with the unfurling of the state flag by the principal, followed by the singing of the Rajyageet. Students dress in traditional attire and perform folk dances like Lavani and Powada. Speeches are delivered about the state's history, culture, and achievements. Posters highlighting Maharashtra's forts, rivers, and festivals are displayed. The celebration ends with a pledge to work for the progress of the state and respect for all workers.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Explain the importance of celebrating days like Maharashtra day and Labour day.
questions.answer: Celebrating days like Maharashtra day and Labour day helps inculcate a sense of pride and belonging among students. Maharashtra day reminds us of the state's formation and its rich cultural heritage, including forts, festivals, and folk songs. Labour day teaches us to respect the dignity of work and appreciate the contributions of workers in various fields. These celebrations promote national integration and awareness of social values. They also encourage students to learn about history, civics, and their responsibilities as citizens. By participating in such events, students develop respect for diversity and the spirit of unity.

Trade unions and organizations often hold rallies and speeches to highlight workers' rights. The day reinforces the idea that societal progress depends on the hard work and dedication of labourers.

questions.chapter: From the Sugarcane to Sweet Gold
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Explain the step-by-step process of making jaggery from sugarcane as shown in the chapter.
questions.answer: First, mature sugarcane is cut from the field and loaded onto bullock-carts or tractors. It is taken to the Gurhal where a machine crushes the cane to extract sweet juice. The juice is poured into a big iron pan and heated over fire. As it boils, steam rises. Workers stir it continuously with long wooden sticks to thicken and brown it. Impurities are removed. The thick juice is then poured into small moulds and left to cool. After some time, solid jaggery blocks are formed, which are removed and packed.

Their teeth are wide and strong, which helps them break the bamboo into small pieces. They also have powerful mouth muscles that allow them to chew for a long time. These features are adaptations because their diet is almost entirely bamboo. Without these strong jaws and teeth, pandas would not be able to eat enough bamboo to survive.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why pandas are in danger and what we can do to help them.
questions.answer: Pandas are in danger because their bamboo forests are being cut down for farming and buildings. This destroys their home and food source. There are only a few pandas left in the wild, so they are at risk of extinction. We can help by protecting forests, supporting wildlife sanctuaries, and spreading awareness. If we save their habitat, pandas can live and breed safely.

questions.text: Why did Gopi and Krishna not keep the golden statue for themselves?

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is the story called 'True Friends'?
questions.answer: The story is called 'True Friends' because Gopi and Krishna demonstrated loyalty, honesty, and selflessness. They supported each other during hardship and chose fairness over personal benefit, which reflects true friendship.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Describe the events that led to the discovery of the golden statue and how it was resolved.
questions.answer: Krishna’s crops were ruined by heavy rains, so his friend Gopi lent him a portion of his land to grow crops. While tilling the land, Krishna unearthed a beautiful golden statue. Both friends, being honest, wanted to do the right thing and approached Raja Krishnadevaraya for guidance. The king admired their honesty and followed Tenali Raman’s suggestion to buy the statue at a fair price. The money was used to help peasants in need, and a pillar was erected in honour of their friendship.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Explain how the story 'True Friends' promotes the values of friendship and honesty.
questions.answer: The story shows that true friends stand by each other in difficult times, as Gopi helped Krishna when his crops were ruined. Despite finding a valuable golden statue, neither friend tried to keep it secretly or claim it selfishly. They approached the king together, showing trust and honesty. Their selfless behaviour impressed the king and courtiers. The resolution — using the statue’s value to help poor farmers — reflects how honesty and friendship can lead to kindness and social good. Thus, the story inspires students to value integrity and loyal companionship.

questions.text: Why does the poet repeat the line 'Touch your leg and stretch your arm'?
questions.answer: The poet repeats this line to involve the reader or listener in the poem through action. It makes the poem interactive and helps children remember the farm activities.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the farmer stamp his foot and clap his hands repeatedly in the poem?
questions.answer: The farmer stamps his foot and claps his hands to express joy and energy while working. It also marks the rhythm of his actions and keeps him active throughout the day. This repetition makes the poem lively and engaging for children.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is it important for the farmer to scare away the birds?
questions.answer: Birds can eat the seeds or damage the young seedlings, which would reduce the crop yield. By scaring them away, the farmer protects his fields and ensures a good harvest. This shows his responsibility and vigilance.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the poem end with merrymaking on the farm?
questions.answer: The merrymaking shows the happiness and success of a completed harvest. It celebrates the farmer’s hard work and the abundance of wheat, jowar and bajra. This ending gives a positive and joyful message about farming.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Describe the daily routine of a farmer as shown in the poem.
questions.answer: The farmer begins his day by sowing seeds in long, narrow rows. He then waters the seeds and removes weeds to help them grow. Throughout the day, he stands guard to scare away birds that might harm the crops. He repeatedly stamps his foot and claps his hands, turning around to check on his lands. At harvest time, he cuts the corn, stands tall, and blows the horn to mark the success. The farm fills with joy as everyone celebrates the merrymaking. This routine shows the farmer’s hard work, care, and happiness in growing wheat, jowar and bajra.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: How does the poem teach us about the importance of farming?
questions.answer: The poem shows that farming involves many careful steps like sowing, watering, weeding, and protecting crops from birds. It highlights the farmer’s hard work and daily dedication to his fields. The repeated actions and joyful harvest teach us that growing food requires patience and effort. The merrymaking at the end reminds us to value and appreciate the food we get from farms. Through simple actions and rhythm, the poem helps children understand the life of a farmer. It builds respect for agriculture and those who work in it. The poem connects learning with movement and joy, making the lesson memorable.

questions.text: Describe how birds build their nests and care for their young.
questions.answer: Birds build nests using twigs, leaves, and feathers in safe places like trees or on the ground. The female bird lays eggs and sits on them to keep them warm. After hatching, the parent birds feed and protect the chicks until they can fly.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the body structure of a bird helps it to fly.
questions.answer: Birds have light bones and strong muscles which make flying easier. Their bodies are shaped like aeroplanes to cut through air smoothly. Wings and flight feathers help them lift and stay in the air.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Write about the different types of feathers and their uses.
questions.answer: Birds have three types of feathers: down feathers keep them warm, body feathers cover their body, and flight feathers help them fly. Each type has a special function based on its structure and location.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: How do birds use their beaks and claws? Give examples.
questions.answer: Birds use their beaks to cut, crush, and pick up food since they have no teeth. Claws are used for catching prey, climbing, walking, or swimming, depending on the bird. For example, eagles use claws to catch fish, and ducks use them to swim.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why can penguins not fly even though they are birds?
questions.answer: Penguins cannot fly because their wings are short and stiff, adapted for swimming rather than flying. Their bodies are heavy and solid, which helps them dive deep in water but makes flying impossible. Thus, they are flightless birds that are excellent swimmers.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do birds have light bones?
questions.answer: Birds have light bones to reduce their body weight, making it easier to fly. Heavy bones would make flying difficult or impossible. Light bones, combined with strong muscles, allow birds to flap their wings easily and stay in the air.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is migration important for birds?
questions.answer: Migration is important because it helps birds find food and suitable weather when their habitat becomes too cold or food becomes scarce. By moving to warmer places, they survive and return later to breed. This yearly journey ensures their survival and reproduction.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Write about the different ways birds use their feet and claws.
questions.answer: Birds use their feet and claws in many ways depending on their habitat and food. Eagles have strong, sharp claws to catch and hold live prey like fish or rabbits. Ducks have webbed feet that help them swim smoothly in water. Hens scratch the ground with their claws to find insects and seeds. Cranes have long toes and legs to walk in muddy water without sinking. Woodpeckers use their claws to grip tree trunks tightly while they peck for insects. Some birds, like parrots, can even hold food or climb using their feet. Thus, feet and claws are adapted to help birds survive in their environment.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Describe the characteristics of birds that make them unique from other animals.
questions.answer: Birds are unique because they are the only animals that have feathers, which help them fly, stay warm, and attract mates. They have beaks instead of teeth and lay hard-shelled eggs. Birds are warm-blooded, meaning their body temperature stays constant like humans. They have light bones and strong muscles that enable flight. Most birds can fly, though some like ostriches and penguins are flightless. They build nests, care for their young, and many migrate long distances. These features together make birds a special and diverse group of animals.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how birds are adapted for flight.
questions.answer: Birds have several adaptations that help them fly. Their bones are light and hollow, reducing body weight. They have strong flight muscles attached to wings that move up and down. Feathers, especially flight feathers, provide lift and help in steering. Their body shape is streamlined like an aeroplane to cut air resistance. Together, these features allow birds to flap their wings easily and stay in the air for long periods.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain why birds do not have teeth and how they manage without them.
questions.answer: Birds do not have teeth because teeth would make their heads heavy, making flight difficult. Instead, they have lightweight beaks made of keratin, which are strong and shaped according to their diet. They use their beaks to pick up, crush, tear, or probe for food. Some birds swallow food whole and break it down in a special part of their stomach called the gizzard. Thus, beaks are efficient alternatives to teeth for birds.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: What values does the poem promote about the country?
questions.answer: The poem promotes patriotism, respect for martyrs, pride in cultural heritage, and unity beyond religious identities. It highlights the value of zero (symbolizing ancient wisdom) and the heroic spirit of soldiers.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain the line 'Sea prostrates at its feet'.
questions.answer: This line means that the sea bows down in respect before the land, symbolizing the land's greatness and dignity. It uses personification to show nature's reverence for the country.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the speaker say he is not Hindu nor Muslim?
questions.answer: The speaker says he is not Hindu nor Muslim to emphasize that his national identity as an Indian comes before any religious identity. He wants to show unity and patriotism above communal divisions.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the speaker call the soldiers his hero?

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Write a paragraph on the central idea of the poem 'I am Indian First'.
questions.answer: The central idea of the poem is that the speaker’s love for India comes above all other identities such as religion, caste, or language. He proudly declares himself Indian first, valuing the country’s rich cultural heritage, ancient wisdom like the concept of zero, and the sacrifices of martyrs and soldiers. The poem promotes national unity, respect for diversity, and patriotism. It inspires children to rise above divisions and cherish their motherland. The imagery of snowy peaks, the sea bowing down, and the Golden Sparrow flying to new heights reflects India’s natural beauty and aspirations. The poem encourages pride in being Indian and working for the nation’s progress.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.

questions.answer: I would give the message 'Unity in Diversity is India’s Strength' on my Republic Day poster. This message is important because India has many languages, religions, and cultures, yet we are one nation. Including images of different states, flags, and children holding hands would show unity. The poster would remind everyone that respecting differences makes our country strong. It would also inspire pride in being Indian and encourage peace and harmony among all citizens.

questions.answer: The story teaches that honesty and cleverness can win over deceit. Even though Hari tried to trick Ramdas, it was Ramdas’s wisdom that won in the end.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Hari lie about being a merchant?
questions.answer: Hari lied about being a merchant to gain Ramdas’s trust so that he could steal from him later. As a thief by profession, he used deception to carry out his plan.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why did Ramdas choose to hide his money in Hari’s bag?
questions.answer: Ramdas hid his money in Hari’s bag because he suspected Hari’s true identity and wanted to outsmart him. He knew a thief would not think to check his own belongings.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why was Hari surprised that a traveller outsmarted him?
questions.answer: Hari was surprised because he considered himself the smartest thief and had never been tricked by anyone before. He did not expect a simple traveller to outwit him.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Narrate the story of 'The Smart Traveller' in your own words.
questions.answer: Ramdas, a cloth merchant, was travelling to Royal Parks when he met Hari, who claimed to be a merchant too. Hari was actually a thief and planned to steal from Ramdas. That night, while Ramdas slept, Hari searched his belongings but found no money. The next day, Ramdas revealed he had hidden the money in Hari’s own bag. Hari, shocked, admitted that no traveller had ever outsmarted him before. The story shows how wisdom and calmness can defeat deceit.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-8 lines.
questions.text: Imagine you are Hari. Write how you felt when you realised Ramdas had outsmarted you.
questions.answer: I felt shocked and embarrassed when I realised that Ramdas had hidden my own money in my bag without me knowing. I had thought myself to be the cleverest thief, but I was fooled so easily. I felt disappointed not because I didn’t get the money, but because I had been outwitted by someone I had underestimated. It made me think about my actions and how honesty is better than trickery.

questions.text: Why is it important to be honest while travelling?
questions.answer: Being honest while travelling builds trust with others and keeps you safe. If you lie, people may suspect you and watch you closely. In the story, Hari’s dishonesty led to his embarrassment, while Ramdas’s honesty and wisdom won.

Regular practice increases concentration and reduces anxiety. Thus, Yogasana maintains both physical fitness and mental peace.

questions.text: What do we see outside the window during the flight and how do they look?

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the aeroplane takes off and climbs into the sky.
questions.answer: The aeroplane starts moving slowly with a rumble-rumble sound, then moves faster with a vroooom sound. The wings stretch wide and the engines roar zoom-zoom, which lifts the aeroplane up into the sky.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Describe the landing process of the aeroplane at Goa airport.
questions.answer: The aeroplane slowly goes down as the pilot says they are ready to land. The wheels touch the ground with a thud, and the wings flap slightly as the plane rolls along the runway with screech and rumble sounds before stopping safely.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do we fasten our seat belts in the aeroplane?
questions.answer: We fasten our seat belts to stay safe in our seats during take-off, flight, and landing. It prevents us from getting hurt if the plane shakes or stops suddenly. The air hostess and pilot remind us to fasten them for our safety.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why does the security officer check our bags and ID-cards?
questions.answer: The security officer checks our bags to make sure we are not carrying anything dangerous. The ID-card is checked to confirm our identity matches the ticket. This ensures the safety of all passengers and the flight.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do we feel joy when the speaker says our flight is ready for boarding?
questions.answer: We feel joy because it means our trip is about to start and we will soon be on the aeroplane. The announcement makes us excited to fly and reach our destination. It is a happy moment after waiting at the gate.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Describe your experience of flying in an aeroplane from Mumbai to Goa as if you are a passenger.
questions.answer: I arrived at the airport with my bag and went to the check-in counter. I showed my ticket and ID-card and got my boarding pass. Then I went through security where my bag went through the whirr-whirr machine and I walked through the beep-beep gate. I waited at the gate and felt happy when the speaker announced our flight was ready for boarding. I walked through the aerobridge and saw the big, shiny aeroplane. The air hostess greeted me with a smile. Inside, I found my seat, fastened my seat belt, and felt the plane rumble and then zoom into the sky. From the window, I saw tiny houses, moving dots of cars, ribbon-like roads, fluffy clouds like cotton candy, and green trees like a carpet. The pilot said the weather was clear and sunny. After some time, we began to land, and I felt the wheels touch the ground with a thud. We rolled on the runway and stopped safely. Flying was full of sounds, sights, and smiles, and I loved every moment of it.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Write a summary of the chapter 'Let’s Fly in an Aeroplane' in your own words.
questions.answer: The chapter 'Let’s Fly in an Aeroplane' describes a journey from Mumbai to Goa by air. It starts with packing and imagining the trip. At the airport, we check in, go through security, and get our boarding passes. We wait at the gate and board through the aerobridge when our flight is called. Inside the aeroplane, we fasten our seat belts as the plane moves, takes off, and flies high. From the window, we see houses, cars, roads, clouds, and trees looking small and beautiful. The pilot announces the clear weather. Finally, the plane lands safely at Goa airport with the wheels touching the ground. The journey is full of sounds like engine roar, beep-beep, whirr-whirr, and sights like shining wings and floating clouds. It ends with the joy of flying and the wish to travel again soon.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain the role of the pilot and air hostess during a flight.
questions.answer: The pilot is responsible for flying the aeroplane safely from take-off to landing. They communicate with air traffic control and announce important information like weather and landing time to passengers. The air hostess greets passengers, helps them find their seats, and ensures their comfort and safety during the flight. They also demonstrate safety procedures and serve food or drinks if needed. Both work together to make the flight smooth and pleasant for everyone on board.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Explain how the sounds and sights during the flight make the journey enjoyable.
questions.answer: The sounds like the engine's vroooom during take-off and the whooosh in the sky make the flight exciting and lively. The beep-beep at security and whirr-whirr of the bag machine add to the airport experience. The sights from the window turn ordinary things into wonderful views — houses like toy blocks, cars like dots, and roads like ribbons. Seeing fluffy clouds and green landscapes from high above makes us feel amazed and happy. Together, these sounds and sights create a joyful and memorable flying experience.

questions.text: Describe how Warli paintings are made.
questions.answer: Warli paintings are made on mud walls using white paint made from rice flour paste. Artists use simple shapes like circles, triangles, and squares to draw people, animals, trees, huts, and the sun. These paintings tell stories about farming, hunting, dancing, fishing, and celebrations.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: What do Warli paintings tell us about their lifestyle?
questions.answer: Warli paintings show that the Warli people are closely connected to nature. They depict their daily activities like farming, hunting, fishing, and dancing. The art reflects their joy, love for nature, and community life.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Describe the Tarpa instrument and how it is played.
questions.answer: The Tarpa is a musical instrument made from bamboo and a dried gourd. A man plays the Tarpa during the Tarpa dance while men and women hold hands and move in a circle. The sound of the Tarpa guides the dance movements.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Where do Warli people live and what are their houses like?
questions.answer: Warli people live in small mud houses with thatched roofs in the forests and hills of Palghar and Thane in Maharashtra. Their homes are simple and made from natural materials like mud and straw. They decorate these houses with beautiful white Warli art.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why do Warli people make paintings on their mud walls?
questions.answer: Warli people make paintings on their mud walls to share their life, joy, and love for nature. The paintings tell stories about their daily activities like farming, dancing, and fishing. It is a way to express their culture and pass it on to future generations.

questions.text: Why is the Tarpa dance performed in a circle?
questions.answer: The Tarpa dance is performed in a circle to show unity and equality among the participants. Holding hands and moving together reflects their community spirit and harmony with nature. The circular motion also represents the cycle of life and nature.

questions.subject: English
questions.text: Why is Warli art not just decoration?
questions.answer: Warli art is not just decoration because it carries deep cultural meaning and stories of the tribe. It reflects their relationship with nature, their daily life, and their celebrations. It is a way of sharing their identity, joy, and values with others.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Describe the Warli art and culture based on the chapter.
questions.answer: The Warli people are one of the oldest tribes in India, living in the green forests and hills of Palghar and Thane in Maharashtra. They live in small mud houses with thatched roofs, which they decorate with beautiful white Warli art. This art is made using rice flour paste and simple shapes like circles, triangles, and squares to show people, animals, trees, huts, and the sun. Their paintings tell stories of farming, hunting, dancing, fishing, and celebrations, showing their love and respect for nature. A famous Warli dance is the Tarpa dance, where men and women hold hands and move in a circle while a man plays the Tarpa, a musical instrument made from bamboo and a dried gourd. Warli art is not just decoration; it is a way to share their life, joy, and connection with nature.

questions.subject: English
questions.instruction: Write a short paragraph in 6-10 lines.
questions.text: Explain how Warli paintings reflect the lifestyle and values of the Warli people.
questions.answer: Warli paintings reflect the simple and nature-centered lifestyle of the Warli people. They show everyday activities like farming, fishing, hunting, and dancing, which are central to their survival and joy. The use of basic shapes indicates their belief in simplicity and harmony. By painting scenes of celebrations and community dances, they highlight the importance of togetherness and happiness. The frequent depiction of trees, animals, and the sun shows their deep respect and gratitude toward nature. Since they use natural materials like rice flour and mud walls, their art is eco-friendly and rooted in their environment. Thus, Warli art is not just a craft but a visual story of their values, traditions, and way of life.
